"''Agreed|The Pyke capo and the Twi'lek majordomo|}} A [[Gender|male]] [[Pyke]] worked as a '''capo''' for the [[Pyke Syndicate]] in [[9 ABY]]. When the syndicate attempted to [[Battle of Mos Espa|seize]] the [[city]] of [[Mos Espa]] from [[Daimyo]] [[Boba Fett]], he led a number of [[Pyke Syndicate Foot Soldier]]s on Fett's position. They were soon met by a [[Mok Shaiz's majordomo|Twi'lek majordomo]] who read out the Daimyo's terms with much prompting from the capo. With the terms being a threat to the Pykes, the capo attempted to kill the [[majordomo]] when Fett and the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] arrived and gunned him and many of his men down. ==Biography== {{Quote|Salutations! Salutations! I am unarmed but for this tablet bearing the terms of surrender. I wish to present it to whomever spokesperson is empowered to deliberate an acceptable outcome in the eyes of the Oba Diah high council.''"
"''Read it to me, tail-head.|The majordomo and the capo|}} In [[9 ABY]], the [[Pyke]] [[Gender|male]] worked as a capo for the [[Pyke Syndicate]]. During the syndicate's [[War against the Pykes|takeover]] of the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], he was deployed as part of an [[Battle of Mos Espa|attack]] on the [[city]] of [[Mos Espa]] to usurp [[Daimyo]] [[Boba Fett]] from his rule there. With the three ruling families of the city turning on Fett's [[Fett gotra|forces]], the [[capo]] led a force of Pyke foot soldiers to the street leading to the [[Sanctuary]], a [[cantina]] which the Pykes had [[Destruction of Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|bombed]] and had since become Fett's hideout. The group of Pykes positioned themselves behind cover in nooks or balconies. [[File:PykeCapoIncredulous-BoBFCh7.png|thumb|left|300px|The capo listens to Boba Fett's terms of surrender read by the Twi'lek majordomo.]] After a short wait, the Pykes were met by a [[Mok Shaiz's majordomo|Twi'lek majordomo]], who exited the ruins of the Sanctuary with what he claimed was terms of surrender from Fett. The capo and a number of his men walked up to the [[majordomo]] and he ordered the [[majordomo]] to read the terms, calling the [[Twi'lek]] a tail-head. The majordomo laughed off the nickname and begun speaking about the [[Obsidian Cliffs]] of the Pyke [[homeworld]]{{Databank|oba-diah|Oba Diah}} [[Oba Diah]] until the capo once again demanded for him to read the terms. The majordomo began reading the terms but paused when he got to Fett's offer, attempting to change the topic. Prompted to continue by the capo, the Twi'lek read Fett's offer, which threatened the deaths of the Pykes if they did not clear off of Tatooine. The capo scowled and exchanged looks with his men before raising his [[blaster]] at the majordomo to execute him. That was when Fett and the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] flew out on [[jetpack]]s and gunned down the Pyke, engaging his men thereafter in a battle that eventually drove the syndicate out of Mos Espa. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Perhaps we should discuss what you'd be willing to…''"
"''Read it.|The majordomo and the capo|}} A Pyke male, the capo had [[Color|light blue]] and beige skin with black [[eye]]s. He was insistent on the Twi'lek majordomo to read out Boba Fett's terms, angrily snapping at the Twi'lek when the majordomo went on a tangent. The capo scowled at Fett's threat to his syndicate, choosing to try and shoot the majordomo as a response. ==Equipment== The Pyke capo wore black [[clothing]] with grey [[armor]] with yellow markings, including the symbol of the Pyke Syndicate on his shoulder pads. He also had brown [[boot]]s and wielded a blaster. ==Behind the scenes== The Pyke capo appeared in and "[[Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor]]" of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which was directed by [[Robert Rodriguez]] and released on [[February 9]] [[2022]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-february-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in February 2022}} He was played by the stunt performer [[Andreas Saenz-Hudson]]. In the character's scene, he wears the costume of a Pyke foot soldier with a yellow mask in the shots when he is hit by a blaster bolt. ==Appearances== *{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=名称不明のパイクのカポ |ka=უცნობი პაიკი კაპო }} [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Pyke Syndicate members]] [[Category:Pykes]]
